name: Grindstones
note: Grindstones take what wears or holds enchantments; one input loses all but its curses (an enchanted book becomes a book), two of a kind merge their durabilities with 5% of the most and the curses of both; the repair cost counts the curses kept; quick moves fill the upper input, then the lower; 25 steps give the same windows and components as both official servers
deviations: taking a result gives experience drawn from the level random, so the client scenario checks only its range
stacks with several enchantments keep them in ascending id order; the official servers keep a hash order of their own, which their windows show
